About the role Driven by rapid growth and a commitment to operational excellence, Trustly is seeking a KYC Analyst to join our Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) function. In this role, you will help safeguard Trustly’s ecosystem through in-depth investigations and risk assessments across both consumer and merchant-related activities. You will work cross-functionally to support complex KYC workflows, transaction monitoring investigations, sanctions and PEP escalations, and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) reviews. content: WHO WE ARE At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide. Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like. Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays. ABOUT THE TEAM Trustly guarantees payments in North America, and every approval and every recovery runs on our risk decisioning and collections platforms. This role owns the product strategy for those platforms and runs the operating rhythm for the Data and Risk organizations, so that our teams plan well, deliver on their commitments, and complete critical risk operations and compliance work on time. WHAT YOU'LL DO LEAD THE RISK DECISIONING AND COLLECTIONS PLATFORMS - Own the product strategy and roadmap for the risk decisioning platform and the collections platform, tied to approval rate, loss and recovery rate. - Lead the risk decisioning platform: the real-time decision engine (scoring path, latency and availability), the facts and scores available at decision time, and self-serve rule and threshold authoring with versioning, simulation, test mode and rollback. - Lead the collections platform: representment, retry and recovery workflows, consumer communications, reconciliation, and collections agency and vendor integrations, within collections regulations. - Lead the risk operations tooling: alert and case management, manual review queues and per-merchant risk settings. - Partner with Risk Engineering on architecture, build-versus-buy decisions, release planning and delivery. ABOUT THE ROLE Trustly is looking for a motivated and experienced Regulatory Compliance Manager to support the development and day-to-day running of the regulatory compliance programme for Trustly in Europe. Trustly’s European business operates primarily through Trustly Group AB (TGAB), a licensed payment institution based in Stockholm and supervised by the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority (Finansinspektionen). TGAB provides account-to-account and open banking payment services across Europe, which places us squarely within a fast-moving and heavily regulated industry. Reporting to the EU/UK Chief Compliance Officer (CCO), the Compliance Manager will support the CCO and the TGAB Compliance Director in executing Trustly’s regulatory compliance strategy. You will implement and manage end-to-end compliance domain programs, including obligations and control mapping, policies and standards, training and advice. Operating within a three-lines-of-defence model, the Compliance Manager will help provide TGAB's Board and Management Team with the reporting they need to exercise effective oversight of compliance operations for the entity. About the role The fraud landscape is rapidly evolving, and our team plays a pivotal role in keeping Trustly safe while ensuring friction-free transactions for legitimate users. We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented Fraud Analyst to join our growing hub in Lisbon. In this role, you will investigate end-to-end fraud claims, dissect first-party and third-party fraud patterns, and lead complex liability claim workflows under UK regulatory frameworks. Working with data query templates and manual extraction tools, you will analyze transaction behaviors, interact directly with external partner banks and merchants, and label crucial data points to continuously strengthen our automated rule sets and machine learning systems. What you’ll do - Independently investigate fraud claims received from partner banks and merchants, assessing incident validity and identifying underlying fraud vectors. - Lead end-to-end investigations on UK legislative liability claims where Trustly holds shared liability, ensuring fair and timely resolution outcomes. - Communicate and collaborate directly with external financial institutions, partner banks, and merchants to gather evidence, resolve disputes, and clarify fraud findings. - Accurately mark and categorize transaction datasets to retrain our automated fraud rules and machine learning models. - Conduct proactive undetected fraud monitoring and analysis across transaction streams using internal extraction tools and SQL query templates. - Collaborate closely with team members across Lisbon and Stockholm to share typologies, refine operational workflows, and improve team playbooks.
